The Best Daycare for Your Beloved Pet!

Azabu Pet is an absolute gem for pet owners in Tokyo! From the moment I stepped in with my dog, Mickey, I knew we’d found the perfect place. They treat your furry family member like their own, providing a level of care and attention that goes above and beyond.

The staff is incredibly kind and accommodating, even when we had a few scheduling challenges. They worked with us to find the best solution, and their patience and understanding really stood out. Whether you’re looking for a short daycare stay or longer-term options, their pricing is reasonable with plenty of flexibility, making it easy to find a plan that works for you.

One of the most delightful services they provided was the amazing photos and daily summary they create of your dog during their stay. Every day I’m celebrating with snapshots of him having the time of his life—playing, making friends, and genuinely enjoying what feels like a summer camp for dogs!

Azabu Pet also offers fantastic grooming services, ensuring your pet looks their best after a day of fun and Their care is exceptional, making it seamless for expats or English-speaking locals to navigate their services.

I strongly recommend Azabu Pet to any pet owner in Japan. Mickey always comes back happy, relaxed, and excited for his next visit. If you're looking for a daycare where your pet will be loved, pampered, and cared for, as if they were family, Azabu Pet is the place to go!

Azabu Pet is the perfect facility for entrusting your beloved dog to care for in Tokyo! From my first visit, I felt this was a truly trustworthy place. The staff treated our pets with care, as if they were their own family, and I was deeply moved by their kindness and consideration.

What particularly impressed me was the kindness and courtesy of the staff. They were flexible and able to accommodate our schedules and requests, allowing me to leave my pet in their care with peace of mind. Their pricing plans are also very reasonable, with a wide range of options, so I was able to choose the plan that best suits my needs.

What particularly impressed me about Azabu Pet was the wonderful photos they took of my dog ​​during his stay! It was such a wonderful experience to be able to see my dog ​​playing with his friends and having fun in the photos. It really felt like he was at summer camp!

Azabu Pet also offers high-quality grooming services, so I look forward to my dog ​​coming home in top condition. They also have full English support, which is an attractive feature for foreign pet owners and those who prefer to speak English.

Since using Azabu Pet, every time I see my dog ​​having fun, I feel so glad I chose them. I would wholeheartedly recommend this facility to all pet owners living in Japan!

We always use your pet sitting service, and our cats are so well cared for! This time, due to a family illness, we had to make a last-minute request, but we are truly grateful for your prompt and courteous response.

The emails you send us are always so thoughtful and full of love for cats; I can't help but read them aloud to my family!

Our cats really dislike pet hotels, and they always get upset stomachs or feel unwell when we leave them there, so we are truly grateful for your service. We will definitely use your services again.

We bring our dog in for grooming every month.

The staff are always very kind, and they are very considerate in handling our dog, who is quite timid and easily frightened by other dogs. We've also left our dog overnight, and they send us a follow-up email at night, which gives us peace of mind.

Our dog often sits down during grooming, but they manage to keep him standing while they cut his fur, which we really appreciate.

When we pick him up, he shows us his belly and cuddles, which shows how kindly the staff treats him. We definitely want to continue using this shop!
